notes.odoo-plasticos-rules: No GlobalCommands-side artifact by design, not by gap. Commit bbc74c3 (2026-07-22, 'cursor rules stabilization') already removed rules/30-odoo-native.mdc, rules/95-plasticos-equipment-policy.mdc, rules/98-odoo-sh-staging.mdc from this repo and moved that content to the consumer repo's own repo-owned .cursor/rules/ overlay (rules/84-cursor-governance-wiring.mdc v3.0.0). Recreating a governance-side addon here would resurrect intentionally-retired content and re-fork a decision already made. The workspaceOpen hook still classifies odoo_plasticos workspaces (exceptions.yaml) for when a real cross-repo addon is authored, but returns no pluginPaths for this capability today.
